summary.scl_sample_observation_histogram_scope: Sample observations across scenes/dates, including repeated spatial locations. Not unique native pixels, land area, or coverage.

methodology.source: Frozen scene-catalog.json + preview-manifest.json + aoi-inventory.json + existing WebP/PNG/NPZ artifacts
methodology.footprint: Affine transform at pixel edges from true EPSG, width and height; GeoJSON edges densified <=1000 m before EPSG:4326 conversion. Original exact projected geometry retained. Not catalogue bbox.
methodology.scl_sampling: 25 single-pixel reads at fractional row/column positions 0.1,0.3,0.5,0.7,0.9 on the coarsest existing SCL overview. No native full-scene read. GDAL HTTP Range may fetch/decompress whole encoded overview blocks; requested output is 25 categorical pixels per scene.
methodology.rgb_sampling: Per grid, choose the lowest scene cloud_percent+0.35*nodata_percent scene. Read native 10m TCI center 3x3 window (9 pixels, 3 bands), and coordinate-pair native 20m SCL values. Water samples do not establish island validity.
methodology.preview_audit: Recount actual alpha, status PNG, clear-count PNG, date PNG, QA NPZ, and contributor indices; compare manifest/metadata/hash.
methodology.rgb_evidence: Existing preview source metadata plus independently recounted preview artifacts; new tiny native RGB center samples are separate from SCL-only overview samples. Neither establishes full-grid or island coverage.

limitations: 172 MGRS entries describe source raster footprints intersecting broad geographic search windows, not an island count and not a provincial land mask.
Footprints include sea and potentially land outside the intended Hainan administrative scope. Neither sovereignty nor a maritime/administrative boundary is inferred.
The source index reuses the 530 selected scenes from the exhausted 2025 catalogue search; it does not fetch or claim pixel inspection of all catalogue matches.

SCL samples use 25 regularly spaced points per selected scene from its coarsest existing categorical overview. Any counts or fractions describe only these sample points. Spatially tiny islands can be missed entirely.
Accepted SCL classes 2,4,5,6 in a sample do not validate corresponding RGB values, guarantee absence of haze/cloud, or implement the preview processing's dilation and strict clear-fraction threshold.
No-source SCL samples mean class 0 at sampled locations only; quality-rejected samples and network failures are separate. No whole-grid absence is inferred.
11 audited previews comprise one broad main-island/nearshore view plus 10 named rectangular display windows. Pixel counts include water, may overlap, and cannot be summed into island/provincial area.
A complete, authoritative island inventory and reusable island/administrative polygons are not present. There is no province-wide completeness percentage or province-area statistic in this audit.

Projected raster corners are exact transformations of catalogue affine grid geometry. EPSG:4326 GeoJSON edges use <=1000 m densification in the native projection; this polyline is a display approximation of transformed raster edges, not a land outline.

methodology.candidate_match: Actual polygon/MultiPolygon intersection against densified true raster footprints; representative-point candidates additionally require exact native-grid pixel coordinates inside the raster.
methodology.representative_point: PointOnSurface on each valid source geometry; independently require polygon.Contains(point). Invalid/missing geometries are retained and not repaired.
methodology.sampling: Up to three existing scenes, sorted by scene cloud_percent+0.35*nodata_percent. One original 10m RGB cell plus one original 20m SCL cell containing the representative point; stop on first nonzero RGB and SCL in 2,4,5,6. Existing read evidence is cached.
methodology.targeted_update: Eight explicit, guarded preferred sources appended to original evidence for specified objects only. One unresolved object retains all twelve rejected trial dates. Other object read evidence is unchanged.

limitations: Includes main Hainan Island and nearshore/offshore named objects. Same names may occur on island and reef polygons or multiple objects.
Only polygonal objects assembled from this extract. Unnamed objects, point-only islands and areas outside the extract are not covered.
Southern Nansha geography is outside the cached extract. The acquired Nansha administrative polygon does not supply the missing island/reef inventory.
Invalid source geometries are recorded here and excluded from the valid geometry layer; no automatic geometry repair was performed.
A polygon object is not necessarily one independent island; names/objects may overlap and reefs can include water.
One interior representative point may describe only one component of a MultiPolygon. Cells can be mixed coastal pixels; accepted SCL water class6 does not imply dry land.
The OSM snapshot is from 2026 while selected imagery is from 2025; shoreline/change/mapping differences are possible.
No island-wide or province-wide area coverage percentage is inferred from source footprints or sparse representative-point samples.
